When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it and Samwise triggers.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, creating a Food token.
Repeat.

2111-2981-6982.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.

Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

3240-5231-5631-6462.description:

Kheru Goldkeeper and Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

11-3368.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{U}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery

Resolve the copy of Reiterate, creating a copy of Reiterate targeting the copy of Reiterate.
Repeat step 5.

Activate Yahenni by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

Resolve the Toph trigger, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Toph
When Toph dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

Repeat from step 2.

3293-5414-5478-5721.easyPrerequisites:

You control a Plains.
3293-5414-5478-5721.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
3293-5414-5478-5721.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.

Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

Resolve Gigantoplasm's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Gigantoplasm's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Body Double by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
You have a way to cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control.
5223-5696-5702.description:
Cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control. Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Put the token Jyoti into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Jyoti's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers that many times.

Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat step 6 until there is only one Springheart Nantuko trigger remaining.
Resolve the final Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Repeat from step 2.

Give Yahenni deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Yahenni using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls, and destroying it due to Yahenni's deathtouch.
Yahenni triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
If you can give Yahenni deathtouch indefinitely, you may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

Spine of Ish Sah enters the battlefield, destroying target permanent.
Repeat.

Pollenbright Druid dies, triggering Magnanimous Magistrate, causing you to remove two reprieve counters from Magnanimous Magistrate and return Pollenbright Druid from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Repeat.

Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
